cases.description: Text track in front of the only picture track.
Picture / text / picture: the export draws the text UNDER the front picture.
Text on the back track under a full-frame picture: the export hides it.
Authored xPercent/yPercent plus scale/x/rotation keyframes on a text clip.
Two caption tracks at different positions in the stack, burned in.
The same caption stack with burn-in off: the export draws no captions.
A text overlay with no picture clip at all.

cases.row: Text: styled caption placed by position (shadow, accent, wide type)
cases.description: A styled cue whose padded raster is wider than the frame: the placement EQ20 fixed and the wrap EQ21 fixed.

cases.row: Text: animated caption templates (per-word entrance, karaoke, bounce, loop)
cases.description: Four cues, four motion languages; samples land mid-entrance and mid-word, where the raster differs every frame.
The chip blurs the delivered picture behind it (schema v24); the monitor must blur the same crop.

cases.row: Text: rotated caption placed off centre
cases.description: Rotation expands the caption canvas; placement must follow the rotated box.

cases.row: Text: burned caption over an effect lane
cases.description: The export burns captions after its effect stage (EQ14): a blur lane under the caption never blurs the caption.

cases.row: Text: caption clip with a blend mode
cases.description: A caption clip's blend mode applies over the picture below it, as for any layer.

cases.row: Text: per-cue style over the track style
cases.description: A cue's own style layers over its track default field by field (ADR 0071).
